pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with high-frequency, irregular edge serrations resembling oak-leaf patterns. Edge gradients show sharp transitions between dark brown and light cream pixels. Spatial area of patches is larger on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored negative space forming a continuous grid. Junction nodes consist of both tri-radial and quad-radial intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is variable, generally wider on the dorsal-flank transition and narrowing towards the posterior.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck displays a repeating jagged silhouette with low vertical amplitude (approx. 5-10 pixel height) and high frequency, contrasting against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five distinct dark-pigmented avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge and upper left flank, creating localized points of external occlusion.
